description: This file defines the UsersApiController class within the Goteo framework, providing API endpoints for managing user data, including listing users, checking availability, uploading avatars, updating user properties, and session keep-alive functionality.

classes.name: UsersApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for user management functions such as listing, checking availability, uploading avatars, updating properties, and session management within the Goteo application framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, disables database replica and cache by default.

methods.name: usersAction
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of users, possibly filtered by search query and role, formatted as a JSON response.

methods.name: getSafeUser
methods.description: Sanitizes and retrieves user data, including sensitive info if the requester has proper permissions.

methods.name: userCheckAction
methods.description: Checks if a user ID or email is available for registration and suggests potential user IDs.

methods.name: userUploadAvatarAction
methods.description: Handles uploading of avatar images for a specified user, with permission checks and error handling.

methods.name: userPropertyAction
methods.description: Retrieves or updates specific properties of a user via GET or PUT requests.

methods.name: keepAliveAction
methods.description: Keeps the user session alive, returning session status and expiry.
